aha: Opened valves never close and the neck pours left first: open the gate-side valve, send the near pearl first (it also crushes the neck jellyfish), only then open the pit valve so the next two stones fill it and the last pearl rolls to the gate.
deadlocks: Opening the left (pit) valve first: the near-side pearl or any surplus has nowhere to go (pit fills with a pearl / a third item rolls the wrong way).
Pushing a stone into the neck while only the gate valve is open: the stone lands on the gate between walls and seals it.
